ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 30% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels, with the majority of high-intensity pixels originating from concentrated scar tissue and a large distal patch on the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base layer is dominated by dark pigmentation (near-zero intensity). High-contrast white mottling is concentrated at the right lobe tip (distal end). Distributed high-intensity annular rings are mapped across the central and lower regions of both lobes, creating a speckled appearance against the dark base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined, deep V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel-based interior angle of 50 degrees, forming a sharp vertex at the junction of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge. The right lobe displays higher-amplitude peaks (jagged protrusions) compared to the left lobe. Serrations occur at a frequency of roughly 1 peak every 15-20 pixels along the edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a strong convex sweep originating from the median notch, terminating in sharp, tapered distal points that curve slightly upward in the 2D plane.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel rings (diameters ranging from 5 to 15 pixels) across the dark ventral surface, particularly dense in the lower-central region of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (white streaks) are visible on the far-left lobe, cutting through the dark pigmentation in a diagonal orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pervasive barnacle attachment scars (annular rosettes) across the entire visible surface and significant jagged irregularities/chipping along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, contiguous high-intensity white patch localized at the distal tip of the right lobe, providing a distinct asymmetry in pigmentation compared to the left lobe.
